case_name: Monika Goyal And Ors vs State Of Punjab And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Punjab and others (Punjab Civil Service (Judicial))

facts_of_case: Various examinees who had appeared at the Preliminary Examination for selection to the Punjab Civil Service (Judicial) on 15.1.2017 are aggrieved with both the Final Answer Key and the Result declared by the Commission.

legal_principles.principle: Right to foreclosure belongs to the mortgagee and not the mortgagor.
legal_principles.held: Only a mortgagee can apply for foreclosure on expiry of mortgage period. Right to redemption comes to an end only by the action of mortgagee when he secures orders for sale or foreclosure.

legal_principles.principle: Right to redemption under Section 60 of Transfer of Property Act cannot be abolished or abrogated by the parties.
legal_principles.held: Once a mortgage, is always a mortgage. Right to redemption comes to an end only by the action of mortgagee when he secures orders for sale or foreclosure.

legal_principles.principle: Right to foreclosure is subject to contract to the contrary between the parties.
legal_principles.held: Section 67 of Transfer of Property Act clearly makes right to foreclosure subject to contract to the contrary between the parties which means they can by agreement abrogate the right of foreclosure.
